originalBrief: Redesign the whole Northwind Coffee Roasters website as an award-level spatial, cinematic and interactive Roast Ledger while preserving content, commerce, contact, navigation, accessibility and legal routes.
userConstraints: Experimental ambition, Full Audit, required prototype and Dreative Dogfood.
Treatments: UX, Mobile, Refined, Motion, Interaction, Media, 3D, Immersive, Cinematic and Experimental.
Prove persistent continuity, structural scroll, spatial media, cinematic pacing and two content-specific interaction peaks.
Author desktop, 390px mobile, reduced motion, keyboard and touch equivalents within runtime budgets.
approvedConcept: Roast Ledger: The Living Batch Record turns Northwind's morning roast into a persistent industrial chronometer and batch ledger that crosses provenance, origin calibration, brew transmutation and subscription resolution.

visualBlueprints.blueprint: A persistent multi-part brass and steel chronometer opens the batch record, then hands its aperture and ledger line into the Probat provenance chapter.
Six preserved coffees occupy a spatial calibration ring while real source pixels reconstruct into the selected origin dossier and commerce target.
The selected batch becomes a four-phase water score, resolves as a subscription seal, and rests into functional contact and policy routes.

intendedSignature: One living industrial batch instrument persists across the route and changes semantic role without becoming a generic decorative canvas.

plannedMechanisms.primary: Persistent procedural industrial chronometer and chapter bus.
plannedMechanisms.fallback: Authored resolved poster and ledger states.

plannedMechanisms.primary: Structural GSAP chapter timeline with cross-section handoffs.
Nine-slice source-pixel reconstruction into selected origin media.
Spatial origin ring with pointer, touch, keyboard and direct controls.
Selected batch transforms through a controlled four-phase water score.

plannedPeaks.description: Content-specific spatial product calibration changes media, dossier, price, cart target and stage response.
The selected origin becomes a temporal water score with setup, active phases and resolution.
